annotations.title: A US ETF's holdings history, file by file

description: One US ETF read from its issuer's own files: every file date the archive holds with the position count and the top 10 weight, one line per step from a file to the next (how many lines entered, exited and moved, the weight carried by the names that changed, the weight that moved, and the share-count turnover once enough files carry share counts), and how its overlap by weight with its ten closest funds moved over those dates. Each step names the file it is compared with; a step across a change of the keys or of the reading of the file is marked restated.

since.description: Only the steps to a file dated on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

ticker.description: A US ETF ticker, for example VOO. Case does not matter.
